mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product ( product_id, product_name, product_price, product_active, product_description, image_url, product_note, category_id ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{productName}, #{productPrice}, #{productActive}, #{productDescription}, #{imageUrl}, #{productNote}, #{categoryId})
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, product_name, product_price, product_active, product_description, image_url, product_note, category_id FROM product WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND product_active = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM product WHERE product_id = #{productId}
SELECT product_active FROM product WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET product_name = #{productName}, product_price = #{productPrice}, product_active = #{productActive}, product_description = #{productDescription}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, product_note = #{productNote}, category_id = #{categoryId} WHERE product_id = #{productId}
